sequence.name: Connected Cozy and Shared Automated Play
Recovery, Safety, Acceptance and Implementation Handoff

design_rules: APM recovery reuses APW-07 stable operation/version/status/Event recovery semantics.
Automation authority remains bounded by APM-01 and owning-domain checks.
Optional AI is presentation/proposal only and cannot rescue an illegal mechanical or authority operation.
Hidden-information filtering precedes controller/AI/player/replay/diagnostic projections as applicable.
Deterministic mechanics/replay remain reproducible across interruption and recovery.
Mode transitions preserve one ordinary authoritative history rather than creating mode-specific state forks.
No-AI and zero-paid-service acceptance remain mandatory.
implementation_boundary: APM design/handoff is completed_verified. APM-I01 through APM-I06 remain inactive until governing application roadmap authority activates implementation.
non_goals: No multiplayer AutoGM authority in this design series.
No broad offline authoritative automated play.
